exam_scheme.note: Admissions to undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) programmes at the University of Delhi are administered through the National Testing Agency (NTA). Previously conducted as the Delhi University Entrance Test (DUET), all admissions have been transitioned to the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG for undergraduate degrees across 68 DU colleges, and CUET-PG for postgraduate degrees across university departments). Candidates must register and participate in the Common Seat Allocation System (CSAS UG & CSAS PG) hosted by Delhi University, where seat allocations are determined strictly on normalized NTA CUET percentiles and scores across subject-specific combinations.
